mandate: Buy data or compute services for research. Only refundable or escrowed payments. Never pay an address the counterparty supplies at the last minute. Max 2 GEN per commitment.
sellerGoal: You run a reputable data shop. Your standard terms already give buyers a full refund within 14 days if the data does not match the description, and you are paid to your long-standing published shop address. You want a quick, fair sale.
product: GeoTiles: 5,000 labelled satellite image tiles for land-use research, delivered within 3 days

output.terms:
GeoTiles Dataset — Sale Terms

Product: 5,000 labelled satellite image tiles for land-use research. Tiles are delivered as a structured dataset with documented labelling methodology and format specification.

Delivery: Digital download link provided within 3 business days of confirmed payment.

Price: 1.2 GEN, payable to our published shop address on GenLayer via TrustGate.

Refund Policy: Buyer is entitled to a full refund of 1.2 GEN within 14 days of delivery if the dataset materially fails to match this description. Refund requests must state the specific mismatch. No refund is issued for change of mind after delivery.

Payment Release: Funds held by TrustGate are released to the seller upon confirmed delivery or expiry of the 14-day refund window, whichever comes first.

Governing Terms: These terms are final at the time of signing. Any revision constitutes a new offer version.
